init_distributed_mode: initialize distributed PyTorch training mode for single, multi-GPU, multi-node, or SLURM jobs
average_metrics: average a dictionary of metrics across all distributed workers with optional weighting
all_reduce: perform an all-reduce operation on a tensor across all distributed processes
save_on_master: save a PyTorch object using torch.save only from the main process
setup_for_distributed: suppress stdout and stderr output from non-master processes in distributed mode
